bin1874-ai-meeting-skill-ai-meeting.description: Run structured AI meetings for plans, product ideas, technical designs, business decisions, feature proposals, and strategy choices. Use when the user wants an AI meeting, AI roundtable, multi-agent discussion, debate, proposal review, plan review, decision review, or wants Codex, Claude Code, qoderclicn, and other CLI agents to analyze a proposal across multiple expert roles, challenge assumptions, preserve per-agent sessions, and produce a final decision report with provenance. 也适用于中文场景：方案评审、多 Agent 讨论、技术路线评审、商业决策评审。
